name.description: Display name shown in the header and page title

insurer_name.description: Who pays claims, if different from name (used in EOB help text)

default_year.description: Plan year selected by default. Omit to use the newest year; set it to hold back a year whose data is incomplete.

fsa_name.description: How the company's FSA is referred to, e.g. "Acme's FSA"

ai_assistant.description: The AI chat tool employees should use to turn a claims report into cost estimates

note.description: Extra advice, e.g. which chat mode to use

claims_report.description: Lets people upload the claims report from claims_portal and get cost estimates

format.description: Which claims reader understands the report layout (src/claims/readers)

service_map.description: The report's service label to candidate category ids, default first

preventive_map.description: Like service_map, for claims the report marks as preventive

add_to_main_service.description: Labels whose cost is added to the main service on the same claim
